title: Privacy Policy — Sephiria Guide
description: Privacy policy for sephiria-guide.com: analytics, hosting logs, advertising, and what the site does not collect.
body:
This policy explains what sephiria-guide.com collects when you visit a page. No account is required to read anything on this site, and there is no sign-in to collect data from.

What we collect

  • Analytics. The site uses Google Analytics 4 (via a first-party script) to understand aggregate traffic: page views, approximate location, device, and referrer. GA may set cookies or use similar storage.
  • Hosting logs. Cloudflare may process standard request logs (IP, user agent, URL) for security and delivery.

No accounts

There is no sign-in, no account, and no user profile on this site. Earlier versions carried an optional third-party sign-in page; that entry point has been removed, and no account data is collected from a reader.

What we do not collect

  • No newsletter signup.
  • No payment data — nothing is sold here.
  • No account records.
  • We do not sell personal information.

Advertising

Pages may include Google AdSense ads (publisher ca-pub-8359621843582672). Google and its partners may use cookies or similar storage to serve and measure those ads, including when an ad request runs. Authorized sellers are listed in ads.txt. See How Google uses information from sites that use their services.

Downloads and third-party links

Mod, skin and pack pages link to the maintainer's own download page. Those sites have their own privacy policies and their own cookies; downloading a file there is outside this site's control.

Contact

Questions about this policy go to the contact page · jeromell@be-winner.com
